definition: Ordinary human beings, viewed as subject to death.
author: Lyman Frank Baum
quote: I am everywhere,” answered the Voice, “but to the eyes of common mortals I am invisible.
example_sentence: Mere mortals queue for hours; regulars walk straight in.
